auditScopeOutsideWriteScope (export at the function named that) reads a changed-file set from resolveScopeChangedFiles (explicit --changed-files, --base, recorded approve base, or porcelain). The writer of a path in that set is unknown. isCliLifecyclePath already skips run.xml, run-ledger.xml, and run/** (F11). It does not match spec.xml or plan.xml. The approve gate is the sanctioned writer of those two files (stampApproveArtifact since C-APPROVAL-FINGERPRINT). auditWriteEvidenceOutsideScope (export at the function named that) reads WriteEvidence content paths from the executor's own ledger. A spec.xml or plan.xml entry there is the executor claiming it wrote the approved spec. That is a real breach signal. The function also calls isCliLifecyclePath (F11) and isDocsPlansPath (F27.1).
